RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 19, 2008/Phalguna 29, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary
Affairs; Rural Development; Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
87
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Thrust to marine exports from Tamil
Nadu by MPEDA
*281. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Marine Produce Export
Development Authority (MPEDA) is
giving sufficient thrust to marine exports
from Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, what is the quantum of export
of marine products from Tamil Nadu in
2006-07 and the current year up to 31st
December, 2007;
(c) whether it is a fact that the MPEDA
has not surveyed the full potential of
marine fisheries of Tuticorin and other
marine areas; and
(d) what steps are proposed to
formulate a special scheme to encourage
local people?
Export of marine products
*282. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total export of marine products
in 2006-07 and 2007-08 upto 31.01.2008;
(b) whether it is a fact that export of
value added marine products has not grown
in the year 2006-07;
(c) what role Marine Product Export
Development Authority (MPEDA) has
played in bringing better marketing
techniques and advice to this export in the
current year;
(d) whether there is a need  to frequently
upgrade the level of skills and knowledge
and capability of MPEDA;
(e) the steps proposed to enhance skills
and knowledge at MPEDA; and
(f) the measures proposed to review
the role of MPEDA?
Secretive purchase of land along
Pakistan border in Rajasthan
†*283. SHRI AJAY MAROO:
SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has

88
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
been drawn to media reports in which it
has been mentioned that the land of certain
areas of Rajasthan along Pakistan border
has been purchased by some unknown
persons in a secretive manner;
(b) if so, the information available with
Government in this regard; and
(c) the action taken in this regard?
NIFT centres
†*284. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of centres of National
Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT)
as on date, location-wise and State-wise;
(b) the details of places where NIFT
centres were opened during the last three
years; and
(c) the expenditure incurred each year
for proper functioning and maintenance
of these centres during the said period,
centre-wise?
Establishing Communication and
Capacity Development Units
*285. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is establishing
Communication and Capacity
Development Units in various States for
drinking water and sanitation;
(b) if so, whether separate units are being
sanctioned for States where drinking water
and sanitation are dealt with by different
Ministries/Departments; and
(c) the number of proposals for
sanctioning separate Communication and
Capacity Development Units pending for
approval with Government?
Revival of sick industries
*286. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the level of
industrial sickness in the country is
increasing;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken or proposed
to be taken by Government for revival of
sick industries?
Applying strategy of Punjab and
Mizoram to wipe out militancy
in other States
*287. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANW ARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has drawn
some basic conclusions from Punjab and
Mizoram from where militancy has been
wiped out;
(b) if so, whether the success of security
forces in these States reflected the need by
other States to adopt a strategy that aimed
at securing the confidence and support of
the local population; and
(c) whether such a course of action will
be charted by the Centre and popularized
amongst insurgency-inflicted States to begin
with?

89
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NREGA knowledge network
*288. SHRIMA TI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether to implement the National
Rural Employment Guarantee Act
(NREGA)  in a better way, Government
has created a mail group called NREGA
knowledge network;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether most of the rural people are
not aware of the various schemes of the
Ministry and thus have remained unaware
of the benefits of the various rural
development schemes; and
(d) if so, to what extent the creation of
mail group will create awareness amongst
rural people about the various rural
development schemes?
Revenue loss due to SEZs
†*289. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is suffering loss of revenue worth more than
one lakh crore rupees every year due to
establishment of Special Economic Zones
(SEZs);
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's point of view in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Ministry of Finance and Ministry of
Commerce differ in their opinion and
attitude with reference to loss of revenue
as a result of setting up of SEZs; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and the
details thereof?
Labourers engaged/retrenched in
PSUs
†*290. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of labourers engaged as
well as retrenched in the Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs) in the last three years
alongwith the names of these PSUs, the
number of labourers engaged in private
sector;
(b) whether the figures of labourers
working in private sector are maintained;
and
(c) if so, the percentage thereof in
multinational companies and their average
monthly income in comparison to Indian
Public Sector and private professions?
Newly fenced areas along Indo-
Bangladesh Border
*291. KUMAR DEEPAK DAS: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) out of total Indo-Bangladesh Border
(IBB) how much length is newly fenced
including border road construction,
State-wise;
(b) how long will it take to complete
newly fenced project;
(c) the present status of IBB road and
fencing implemented by the Central
Government;
(d) whether many complaints have been
made about the self-centred activities of
National Buildings Construction
Corporation (NBCC) which has been
entrusted the works of border fencing and
border road construction;

90
(e) if so, the action taken thereon;
(f) whether it is a fact that the riverine
border is not totally safe; and
(g) how the reverine border is managed
or checked?
Decline in industrial growth in the
country
*292. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that industrial
growth in the country has declined
significantly in 2007 as compared to the
year 2006;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) how far the decline in industrial
growth is due to the appreciation of the
rupee vis-a-vis the US dollar; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to
increase industrial growth?
Old forts in the grip of Maoists
*293. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
grand forts associated with the warrior-ruler
in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, namely Rohtas
Fort and Kalinjar Fort respectively, are in
the grip of Maoist extremists as reported
in the media;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such old forts which are
tourist attraction are in the grip  of Maoists
and neither the Union Government nor
State Governments have taken any steps
to get them free from the clutches of
Maoists; and
(d) if so, the remedial steps Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Setting up of V ocational Training
Institutes for women
*294. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has set up
V ocational Training Institutes to cater to
the vocational training needs exclusively
for women in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is also a proposal to
set up such an Institute in various parts of
the country, particularly in Tamil Nadu;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the time by when the said Institute
is likely to be set up?
Closing down of weaver cooperative
societies in A.P.
*295. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:  Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 390 weaver
cooperative societies out of a total 1412
societies in the State of Andhra Pradesh
have closed down recently because of the
loan and interest burden on the weavers;
(b) if so, whether any relief measures
are taken up for implementation to help
the weaver cooperative societies to come
out of distress;
(c) if so, the details thereof;

91
(d) how much of the outstanding loan
and interest, which is to the tune of Rs. 52
crore in the State, would be waived; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Opposition to extension of visa to
Ms. Tasleema
†*296. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
 Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
people are opposing extension of visa to
Ms. Tasleema;
(b) whether she has asked for refuge;
(c) whether her novel  'Lajja' is the cause
behind it;
(d) whether her health is a matter of
concern; and
(e) whether some specific measures are
being taken to keep her mentally fit?
Leakage of funds meant for rural
development
*297. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
process of releasing funds for rural
development is cumbersome, since first it
goes to State capitals wherefrom it goes to
district headquarters and in the process lots
of leakages of funds do take place; and
(b) if so, the details of steps
Government is taking to plug the leakages?
Sensitizing panchayats about NREGS
*298. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) as the National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) is covering
330 districts from April, 2007, whether
fool-proof modalities have been evolved to
avoid any discrepancies pointed out in the
CAG Report for period covering February,
2006-March, 2007; and
(b) as the Gram Panchayats have been
actively involved in issuance of Job-Cards
and giving work or compensation thereof
to the eligible rural household, whether
panchayats have been sensitized to extend
positive support to help intended
beneficiaries under this scheme?
Theft of expensive components of T-90
tanks
†*299. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the incident
of theft of very expensive components of
T-90 tanks from the Gun Carriage Factory,
Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh has come to
light;
(b) if so, the names of the components
with their cost and the action taken so far
after this incident;
(c) whether it is the first instance of
theft or such theft has taken place earlier
also; and
(d) the details of action taken by
Government and efforts being made for
prevention of theft from the important
ordnance factory of the country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

92
Establishment of Military Tribunal
*300. SHRI HARISH RAW AT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has recently
decided to set up a Military Tribunal in the
country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 13th March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 23, 1929 (Saka)
(c) whether Government also proposes
to set up its Benches in different parts of
the country;
(d) whether a Bench of the Tribunal is
likely to be set up in the State of
Uttarakhand; and
(e) if so, the details in this regard?
